from_your_person:
In isolation you were my machine
my heart numb began to humm.
what could this mean?
In solitude, I found it quite serene my mind
too stubborn, loud and proud.
for once at peace with this scene.

[heart, rose, banner: you & me]

From blood, loves seed grew thorns deep.
The interdependency isn't quick,
it creeps your foil now mine to keep.
now bound as one, what else
shall we seek?

— dated 8/25/26
Letter in the house this morning.
